text:
Hi All,

Thank you again for taking the time to join the demo earlier today. It was
a real pleasure to connect with everyone and learn more about the work
you’re doing around video perception for manipulation robotics.It was
particularly helpful to hear about some of the challenges you’re facing
with your current Labelbox tooling.

   temporally-aware annotation and tracking is critical to increase
   annotation throughput and label quality.
   2. *Multimodal & multiview data:* Currently Amazon Robotics are limited
   by the absence of configurable UIs and support for syncing multi-angle

   3. *Native support for SAM2 & flexible model integration:* Encord has

   but also supports the integration of custom models to ensure
   efficient annotation tailored to unique annotation scenarios.
   4. *Customizable QA Workflows & automated comparison*: create flexible
   annotation workflows, through agentic workflows enable the integration of
   pre-labelling models or Python code to customize the definition of
